findings.title: ListEntries returns three values but the new test captures only two
findings.evidence: WordbookRepo.ListEntries signature is ([]*wordbook.Entry, int64, error); the assignment `entries, err := repo.ListEntries(...)` does not compile.
findings.recommendation: Capture the total explicitly, e.g. `entries, total, err := ...`, then assert total == 2; or use `entries, _, err := ...`.

recommendations: Add a CreateCardsIfAbsent test with one new valid card followed by nil, then assert no row was inserted.
After cancellation in MarkPlacementAtomic, assert the stored draft and statuses remain unchanged.
